verdict.rationale: HeyGen's core model is a reusable avatar or digital twin, documented as having a 'consistent identity' (heygen-docs-19, heygen-docs-13), so the same character carries across clips. Cinematic avatar videos add multi-shot prompts with scene direction on top of that avatar (heygen-docs-18), and Video Agent revisions keep untouched scenes' script and visuals intact (heygen-docs-11). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scene/environment or style consistency across separately generated shots, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-shot consistency.
